text.title: Go Project Structure Failure Modes
text.summary: Antipatterns observed in real go-project-structure deployments. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + fix.

antipattern.symptom: cmd/api/main.go grows past 500 lines and holds HTTP handlers and SQL queries alongside the wiring.
antipattern.root-cause: Author kept adding "just one more thing" to main.go until it became the whole application; nothing forced the split.
antipattern.fix: Extract handler + service + repository into internal/. Reduce main.go to config load, dependency wiring and app.Run(ctx). See rule cmd-thin-entry-point.

antipattern.symptom: Build fails with "import cycle not allowed" after internal/orders and internal/payments grew to import each other.
antipattern.root-cause: Cross-feature dependencies grew bidirectional, and the reflexive fix was to export more symbols upward instead of inverting one side.
antipattern.fix: Invert one direction via an interface declared at the consumer, or extract a third package owning the shared types. Document the boundary. See rule no-cyclic-dependencies.

antipattern.symptom: Project root accumulates scripts/, tools/, helpers/ and scratch/ with overlapping contents.
antipattern.root-cause: No top-level discipline; every helper added its own directory rather than a Make target.
antipattern.fix: Consolidate into Makefile orchestration; move runnable helpers to cmd/<helper>/; delete one-off scripts once the intent is captured in a target. See rules makefile-orchestrates + no-top-level-loose-files.

antipattern.symptom: wire or fx appears in go.mod on day one, on a service whose hand-wiring would be 20 lines.
antipattern.root-cause: Generators reach for a DI framework by reflex. The trigger should be evidence, not taste.
antipattern.fix: Hand-wire constructors in main.go until that wiring passes ~100 lines; only then adopt wire. See rule cmd-thin-entry-point.

antipattern.symptom: Repository methods take no context.Context, so nothing downstream of a cancelled request actually stops.
antipattern.root-cause: Generated repository signatures omit ctx because the tutorial they imitate predates context plumbing.
antipattern.fix: Thread context.Context as the first parameter through handler → service → repository; enable the contextcheck linter in .golangci.yml. See rule graceful-shutdown-complete.

antipattern.symptom: A 300-line tool ships with cmd/, internal/, pkg/, api/, deployments/ and docs/ — most of them empty.
antipattern.root-cause: The community layout gets quoted as canon, so the full tree is materialised before there is anything to put in it.
antipattern.fix: Require the size threshold in Applies-If (~1kloc or ≥2 binaries) before adopting the layout; otherwise keep main.go next to go.mod. See rule skip-this-methodology.

antipattern.symptom: Interface UserRepository defined inside internal/repository; service must import repository just to depend on it.
antipattern.root-cause: Author inverted Go idiom — interface lives at producer, not consumer.
antipattern.fix: Move the interface to the service file. Repository package only provides concrete impl.

antipattern.symptom: var DB *sql.DB at package level; handlers reach for the global directly; tests cannot mock.
antipattern.root-cause: Author copy-pasted tutorial code that uses globals for brevity.
antipattern.fix: Constructor injection. Pass *sql.DB into handlers via struct field; parallel tests get isolated instances.

antipattern.symptom: pkg/ directory holds private helpers and business logic that no external module imports.
antipattern.root-cause: Author treats pkg/ as 'public-by-convention'; once code is there, moving it to internal/ is a breaking change.
antipattern.fix: Reject pkg/ unless an external module is named that imports from it. Default to internal/.

antipattern.symptom: main.go calls srv.Shutdown(ctx) but leaks worker goroutines and the DB pool stays open.
antipattern.root-cause: Author treated srv.Shutdown as a complete shutdown signal.
antipattern.fix: Drain background goroutines via ctx.Done(); db.Close() after; signal each consumer to quit explicitly.

antipattern.symptom: Dockerfile lacks USER directive; binary runs as root in the runtime stage.
antipattern.root-cause: Generated Dockerfile copied without prod hardening.
antipattern.fix: Add USER nobody:nobody; switch runtime stage to distroless or scratch.
